raw_description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: PST

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is a fast-growing creative studio building an always-on editorial team. They produce short-form social content and vertical episodic drama at volume for top-tier clients, including a premium apparel brand and an entertainment platform aiming to become the "Netflix of gaming." Operating with a philosophy of "thoughtful output," our client balances high-volume production with a deep care for every single piece of content created.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Gaming Video Editor (Narrative & Short-Form) to serve as the narrative engine of a specialized offshore production pod. Reporting directly to the Directors of Editorial, this role is dedicated to cutting episodic, serial short-form micro-dramas shot in-engine (Roblox, Fortnite, GTA, Minecraft). The ideal candidate combines deep gaming culture literacy with sharp narrative storytelling instincts to hold audience attention across serialized episodes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Edit 60-to-90-second vertical, serial micro-drama episodes from raw in-engine gameplay and creator footage.
- Manage end-to-end story edits, sound design, color grading, and on-screen graphics for episodic drops.
- Pace episodes to maximize viewer retention, focusing heavily on cold opens, narrative turns, and cliffhangers.
- Maintain strict process discipline: accurately name assets to project taxonomy, tag, file, and deliver cuts with concise notes.
- Work efficiently across defined effort tiers, knowing when an edit needs a 1-hour story polish versus a quick trim.
- Flexibly cover social, hype, or brand editing tasks for pod teammates during heavy production weeks.

COMPETENCIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

MUST-HAVE

- Gaming Literacy: Active player/enthusiast in gaming culture, specifically Roblox, Fortnite, GTA, and Minecraft. Intuitively understands community tropes, "flex" moments, and platform nuances.
- Narrative & Story Instinct: Proven experience cutting serialized short-form drama, vertical narrative formats (e.g., ReelShort, DramaBox formats), or story-driven gaming content.
- Pacing & Sound Design: Strong instinct for music choice, audio leveling, and cut timing that builds narrative tension without relying on generic stock audio.
- Technical Proficiency: Fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (learning on the job is not permitted).
- Language & Communication: Strong written English skills to give and receive feedback clearly without translation layers.
- Hardware Setup: Must own a machine capable of 4K multicam editing (Apple Silicon M2+ or PC with dedicated GPU and 16GB+ RAM), dual displays (at least one 1440p), fiber internet (25Mbps+ upload) with a backup line, a UPS, and professional mixing headphones/monitors.

Nice-to-Have

- Motion graphics skills in After Effects (titles, lower thirds, callouts).
- Color grading experience (applying LUTs and maintaining visual consistency across an episode).
- Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools (transcription, selects, automated caption generation, upscaling).
- Prior experience cutting directly for popular gaming creators or gaming channels.

Key Qualities

- Self-Starter: Takes initiative from the queue without waiting for individual task assignments.
- End-to-End Owner: Owns the cut from raw footage through to correctly tagged, filed, and annotated delivery.
- Tasteful & Receptive: Strong personal taste and creative opinion, but accepts directional changes from leadership without ego.
- Proactive Communicator: Flags unusable footage, unclear briefs, or schedule risks on day one.
- Low Drama, High Output: Calm, dependable, and focused on maintaining high standards at scale.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% Remote Work - Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
- Career Growth Opportunities - Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.
- Collaborative & Innovative Team - Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

APPLICATION PROCESS

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
